record.question: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) is located in
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
ISRO identifies NRSC as the National Remote Sensing Centre at Hyderabad. It is responsible for acquisition and processing of remote-sensing satellite data, data dissemination, aerial remote sensing, and disaster-management decision support. This is the Department of Space centre asked for; the listed cities Mumbai, Dehradun, and Chennai are not the NRSC location given by ISRO.

Reference: https://www.isro.gov.in/NRSC.html
